text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> crossed the finish line in 1st place. The 
crowd erupted with comments full of 
anticipation for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then, the entrants for the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe were announced. The 
names called were <chrname> and three others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even among those who weren't selected, 
some volunteered to assist with the 
expedition, while others offered loud 
cheers of support despite their 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carrying their hopes as "Japan's 
representative," she first begins 
preparations for the preparatory race, the 
Prix Niel.
